capabilities: display wallpapers behind the workspace from images, videos, web pages, URLs and built-in effects
compose layered scenes in a visual editor without code
write HTML and JavaScript wallpaper packages with user-defined settings
run a slideshow on a timer with ordering, shuffling and cross-fade
adjust readability dimming, blur, brightness, saturation and mouse parallax per wallpaper or globally
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. Web-page wallpapers and packages run in a sandboxed frame but can still make network requests; the plugin itself makes none. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's workspace background is static and opaque, with no built-in way to show animated or custom wallpapers behind the interface.

relations.evidence: A folder containing a Wallpaper Engine web wallpaper (project.json) can be added with + → Vault folder

summary: Animated wallpapers rendered behind the Obsidian workspace, using images, videos, web pages, built-in effects and code-free layered scenes.
